tfmg.inspector.multiblock.controller_unl: The controller of this structure is in an unloaded chunk
tfmg.inspector.air_intake.member: Part of a bigger intake run by the block at %s %s %s:

tfmg.inspector.air_intake.too_slow: Too slow: %s RPM, under the %s RPM a %sx%s intake needs to make any air
tfmg.inspector.air_intake.too_slow.fix: Turn it at %s RPM or more (a 2x2 intake already works from 10 RPM, a 3x3 from 5 RPM).
tfmg.inspector.air_intake.production: Producing %s mB of Air per tick at %s RPM
tfmg.inspector.air_intake.full: Air tank full (%s / %s mB): production has stopped
tfmg.inspector.air_intake.full.fix: Pump the Air out of the intake (any face) to a Blast Stove, an engine or a tank.
tfmg.inspector.air_intake.grow: Air per tick = RPM x size x size / 40: a 2x2 makes 4 times and a 3x3 9 times as much at the same speed
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.not_loaded: Part of the furnace is in an unloaded chunk: showing its last known state
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.too_short: Structure only %s layers high: at least 3 complete layers are needed (max %s)
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.taller: A taller furnace smelts faster: add complete layers on top
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.not_reinfor: Not reinforced: a furnace built only from reinforced walls and supports smelts twice as fast
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.fault.base: The shaft floor right behind the output (%s %s %s) is %s, not a furnace wall block
Place Fireproof Bricks (or Reinforced Fireproof Bricks or a Block of Steel) at %s %s %s, directly behind the output.
Put Fireproof Bricks, Reinforced Fireproof Bricks or a Block of Steel at %s %s %s: the middle of each side of every layer is a wall block.

Replace it with Fireproof Bricks. Keep a single hatch in the walls for hot air; the furnace gas hatch goes on top of the shaft, not in the walls.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.fault.cente: Layer %s: the shaft at %s %s %s is blocked by %s
Clear it: above the bottom layer, the middle column must stay empty (air).
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.fault.corne: Put a Fireproof Brick Reinforcement, a Blast Furnace Reinforcement or a Block of Steel at %s %s %s: every corner of every layer needs one.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_ore.fix: Throw ore (crushed raw iron, for example) into the shaft from the top, or feed the output block with a funnel, chute or hopper. JEI lists what it smelts.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_recipe.f: Check the Industrial Blasting recipes in JEI: a datapack may have removed this one.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.fuel: Fuel: %s / %s Coal Coke Dust, one lasts %s ticks of smelting
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_fuel.fix: Throw Coal Coke Dust into the shaft or insert it into the output block (it stores up to 64).
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_flux.fix: Throw %s into the shaft or insert it into the output block.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.wrong_flux: The flux slot holds %s, but this recipe needs %s
The flux slot cannot be emptied by hand: feed an ore whose recipe uses this flux until it is used up.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_hatch: No Blast Furnace Hatch in the walls: no hot air can get in
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_hatch.fi: Replace one wall block (the middle of a side, any layer) with a Blast Furnace Hatch and pipe Hot Air into it.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.no_hot_air: The hatch at %s %s %s holds no Hot Air
Pump Hot Air from the top of a Blast Stove into that hatch.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.hatch_wrong: The wall hatch holds %s instead of Hot Air
Pump the %s out of the hatch, then feed it only Hot Air from a Blast Stove.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.hot_air_low: Not enough Hot Air: %s mB in the hatch, the recipe burns %s mB every tick
Supply at least %s mB of Hot Air per tick: a bigger Blast Stove, or several, feeding the hatch.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.hot_air: Hot Air: %s mB in the hatch, the recipe burns %s mB per tick
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.hot_air_sto: Hot Air: %s mB in the hatch
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.output_othe: An output tank holds %s, but the recipe makes %s
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.output_drai: Pump the %s out of the output block (metal and slag both come out of it) into tanks or Casting Basins.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace.gas_hatch: Furnace gas collects in the hatch on top (%s %s %s)

tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace_hatch.unuse: Not part of a formed blast furnace
Build it into the middle of a furnace wall to let Hot Air in, or place it right above the top of the shaft to collect furnace gas. The furnace needs at least 3 complete layers.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace_hatch.role_: Gas hatch on top of the furnace whose output is at %s %s %s: pump the furnace gas out of it
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace_hatch.gas_f: Full: new furnace gas is lost
Pump the furnace gas into a Blast Stove (top or bottom face) or a tank.
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace_hatch.role_: Hot Air inlet of the furnace whose output is at %s %s %s
tfmg.inspector.blast_furnace_hatch.item: Holds %s x %s (items drop out when the block below is air)
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.no_controller: This stove block lost its controller
Break and replace one stove block to re-form the stove.
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.no_air: No Air in the air tank
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.no_air.fix: Pump Air from Air Intakes into a SIDE of the stove's bottom layer.
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.wrong_fuel: The fuel tank holds %s, not Furnace Gas or Creosote
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.wrong_input.f: Input tanks cannot be pumped out: break every block of the stove and rebuild it to clear them, then pipe in only the right fluid.
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.low_air: Only %s mB of Air, a cycle needs at least %s mB
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.no_fuel.fix: Pump Furnace Gas (from the blast furnace's top hatch) or Creosote (from a Coke Oven) into the TOP or BOTTOM face.
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.low_fuel: Only %s mB of fuel, a cycle needs at least %s mB
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.no_recipe: No Hot Blast recipe for %s with %s
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.no_recipe.fix: Check the Blast Stove recipes in JEI.
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.hot_air_full: Hot Air tank full (%s / %s mB): the stove has stopped
Pump Hot Air out of the TOP (or bottom) face into the blast furnace's wall hatch.

tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.co2_full.fix: Carbon dioxide must be pumped out of a SIDE of the bottom layer, into an Exhaust or a Smokestack.
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.co2_space: Carbon dioxide tank: %s / %s mB (pump it out of a side of the bottom layer)
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.rate: Makes about %s mB of Hot Air per tick at this size (one batch every %s ticks)
tfmg.inspector.blast_stove.grow: A bigger stove heats more air: build it 2x2 wide and taller.
tfmg.inspector.casting_basin.output_wait: %s is waiting in the basin: nothing is cast until it is taken
Right-click the basin with an empty hand, or pull it out with a funnel, hopper or chute.
tfmg.inspector.casting_basin.empty.fix: Pipe molten metal (from a blast furnace output) into the basin; it holds 1000 mB.
tfmg.inspector.casting_basin.no_recipe.f: Pump the %s out and feed a fluid that has a Casting recipe (see JEI).
tfmg.inspector.casting_basin.not_enough: %s / %s mB of %s: not enough to cast %s
tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.no_controller: This oven block lost its controller
tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.no_controller.f: Break and replace the bottom front corner oven to re-form the structure.
tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.member: Part of the coke oven run by the block at %s %s %s:

tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.co2_full: Carbon dioxide tank full (%s / %s mB): the oven is paused
tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.co2_full.fix: Pump the %s out of the TOP face of any oven block, into an Exhaust or a Smokestack.
tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.byproducts: Every tick of coking makes %s mB of %s and %s mB of %s
tfmg.inspector.coke_oven.output: The coke drops out in front of the controller, at %s %s %s

tfmg.inspector.concrete_hose.low: Only %s mB of Liquid Concrete: it pours 1000 mB at a time

tfmg.inspector.distillation.too_low: The steel tank is %s high: %s outputs need it at least %s high

tfmg.inspector.distillation.too_thin: %s outputs need a steel tank at least 2 wide

tfmg.inspector.distillation.no_recipe.fi: Empty the steel tank and fill it with Crude Oil or Heavy Oil (see JEI).
tfmg.inspector.distillation.wrong_output: %s cannot be distilled with %s outputs; its recipes need %s
Add or remove output stages (with their pipes) to get exactly %s.

Stack the outputs above the controller with exactly one Industrial Pipe between stages and no gap.

tfmg.inspector.firebox.no_fuel: No fuel: it needs at least %s mB to light

tfmg.inspector.firebox.low_fuel: %s: only %s mB, at least %s mB needed to burn

tfmg.inspector.firebox.exhaust_off: Exhaust management is disabled in the config
tfmg.inspector.firebox.burning: Burning: it heats what stands on it

Connect rotation to the Machine Input below the crank.
tfmg.inspector.pumpjack.crank_driven: Crank driven by its Machine Input at %s RPM

tfmg.inspector.pumpjack.base_unlinked: No pumpjack hammer uses this base
